ambient_events: Cable runs march along the low ceiling, humming with contained power.
A diagnostic panel scrolls green figures no one is reading.
The deck vibrates faintly, the engine's pulse felt more than heard.
description: The engineering corridor, a narrow spine of grated deck and exposed conduit running the length of the lower deck. Everything down here is function over form, but even the pipework is machined to a tolerance that whispers money. The staircase climbs (UP) to the foyer. The engine room lies FORWARD (NORTH); the broadcast complex, AFT (SOUTH).
name: Echelon — Engineering Corridor
